subject: System Design
title: API Gateways
description: A tiny lesson with a big payoff: API Gateways.

hook.text: A mobile app needs data from 5 microservices. Should it make 5 separate API calls? That's slow and fragile.

buildup.text: An API gateway sits between clients and services. It routes, aggregates, and transforms requests.

discovery.text: The gateway combines multiple service calls into one client-friendly response, reducing round trips.

twist.text: The gateway becomes a single point of failure. If it's down, every service is unreachable from the outside.

climax.text: API gateways also handle authentication, rate limiting, and SSL termination — centralizing cross-cutting concerns.

punchline.text: One front door for all services — route, aggregate, protect.

quiz.question: What does an API gateway do?
options: Routes, aggregates, and transforms requests between clients and services
